collection.title: Jaguar I-Pace 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Jaguar I-Pace 2018 Onwards which requires a 27" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 20" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Fit Press Button attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
